description: Cross-platform hierarchical note taking application with focus on building large personal knowledge bases (fork of Trilium Notes).

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of Trilium 0.105.0, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. The definition comes from Runtipi's app store.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Asks you to set a password the first time you open it; there is one account.
Notes live in the app's folder, and its desktop apps can sync with this address.
